description: This file defines a 'Tab' class for managing browser tab interactions within a testing or automation framework, including event handling, request/response logging, snapshot capturing, and modal/dialog management.

classes.name: Tab
classes.description: Represents a browser tab, managing events, requests, console logs, snapshots, and dialogs within a testing framework.

classes.name: ConsoleMessage
classes.description: Represents a console message with type, timestamp, text, and a string conversion method.

methods.name: collectConsoleMessages
methods.description: Collects console messages and page errors from a page.

methods.name: headerSnapshot
methods.description: Captures the current tab header info, including title, URL, and console message count.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates the tab to a specified URL, handling downloads and load state.

methods.name: consoleMessageCount
methods.description: Returns the count of console messages, errors, and warnings.

methods.name: captureSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of the tab's current state, including ARIA snapshot, modal states, and recent events.
